description: Join OSINT analysts Bri Benson and Rae Baker as they use their specialties in missing persons and counter human trafficking cases to guide you through identifying weak spots in your family's online privacy. In this talk, you'll learn practical ways to shrink your digital footprint through hands-on activities and case studies. This talk is aimed at both those already familiar with cyber security as well as anyone who desires to improve online privacy practices with their family, friends, and kids in mind.
